equations.expression: dif v = (Delta t \/ C)(-g_L (v - E_L) + I)
h^t = f(h^(t-1), x^t; theta), quad y^t = g(h^t; theta)
(partial cal(L)) / (partial theta_k) = sum_(t=1)^T (lambda^t)^top (partial f(h^(t-1), x^t; theta)) / (partial theta_k).
L_"CE" = -(1) / (B) sum_(b=1)^B log (exp(hat(y)_(b, c_b))) / (sum_k exp(hat(y)_(b, k)))

r_b = 1 / (N_E D) sum_(n in E) z_(b n), quad
    cal(L)_"fr" = s_u / B sum_b "ReLU"(r_b - r_"max")^2
X_(i j) tilde cal(N)(mu, sigma^2), quad U_(i j) = max(0, X_(i j)).
g^(t+1) = beta g^t + s^t W, quad beta = e^(-Delta t / tau). quad (2)

g_"tot" = g_L + g_e + g_i, quad
    V_oo = (g_L E_L + g_e E_e + g_i E_i) / g_"tot", quad
    alpha = e^(-Delta t g_"tot" / C_m). quad (3)
d v = (V_oo - V)(1-alpha), quad U = V + F_(1/gamma)(d v). quad (4)

kappa_q = (1-alpha)(E_q - V_oo)/g_"tot"
    - (Delta t / C_m) alpha (V - V_oo). quad (6)
partial U / partial g_q = kappa_q / gamma

z_"voltage" = 1 / N sum_(t=1)^N v(t), quad
      z_"count" = sum_(t=1)^N s(t). quad "(1)"
L = L_"CE" + lambda lr(⟨max(0, r - r_"max")^2⟩)_"batch". quad "(2)"
"CE" = -log p_y = log(1 + sum_(k != y) e^(z_k - z_y)) quad "(2)"

r_b = 1 / (N_E T) sum_(n in E) z_(b n), quad
      L_"rate" = lambda / B sum_b max(r_b - r_"max", 0)^2.

tau_E dot(E) &= -E + Phi_E (I_"ext" - 15 g_i^E), \
      tau_I dot(I) &= -I + Phi_I (65 g_e^I), \
      tau_"AMPA" dot(g)_e^I &= -g_e^I + tau_"AMPA" tilde(W)^(E I) E, \
      tau_"GABA" dot(g)_i^E &= -g_i^E + tau_"GABA" tilde(W)^(I E) I.
C_m^E dot(V)^E = -g_L^E (V^E - E_L) - g_e^E (V^E - E_e) - g_i^E (V^E - E_i)

s_(t+1) = bb(1)[V >= V_"th"], quad V <- V_"reset" "if " s_(t+1)=1
    " or refractory"
g^E_(e,t+1) = e^(-Delta t \/ tau_"AMPA") g^E_(e,t) + W_"in" s^"inp"_t
g^E_(i,t+1) = e^(-Delta t \/ tau_"GABA") g^E_(i,t) + W_"ie" s^i_t
g^I_(e,t+1) = e^(-Delta t \/ tau_"AMPA") g^I_(e,t) + W_"ei" s^e_t
tau dot(g) = -g + tau sum W s
C_m^E dot(V)^E = -g_L^E (V^E - E_L) - g_i^E (V^E - E_i) + I_"ext"
tau_"AMPA" dot(g)_e^I = -g_e^I + tau_"AMPA" W^(E I) s^E (t)
tau_"GABA" dot(g)_i^E = -g_i^E + tau_"GABA" W^(I E) s^I (t)
W^(E I) s^E = sum_j W^(E I)_(k j) s_j^E
W^(I E) s^I = sum_k W^(I E)_(j k) s_k^I
sum_j W^(E I)_(k j) s_j^E --> w^(E I) sum_j s_j^E = w^(E I) N_E E(t)
sum_k W^(I E)_(j k) s_k^I --> w^(I E) sum_k s_k^I = w^(I E) N_I I(t)

E(t) eq.triple 1/N_E sum_(j=1)^(N_E) s_j^E (t), quad
    I(t) eq.triple 1/N_I sum_(k=1)^(N_I) s_k^I (t).
tilde(W)^(E I) eq.triple w^(E I) N_E, quad tilde(W)^(I E) eq.triple w^(I E) N_I
tau_"AMPA" dot(g)_e^I = -g_e^I + tau_"AMPA" tilde(W)^(E I) E
tau_"GABA" dot(g)_i^E = -g_i^E + tau_"GABA" tilde(W)^(I E) I

C_m^E dot(V)_j^E & = -g_L^E (V_j^E - E_L) - g_i^E (V_j^E - E_i) + I_"ext" \
         C_m^I dot(V)_k^I & = -g_L^I (V_k^I - E_L) - g_e^I (V_k^I - E_e) \
    tau_"AMPA" dot(g)_e^I & = -g_e^I + tau_"AMPA" tilde(W)^(E I) E \
    tau_"GABA" dot(g)_i^E & = -g_i^E + tau_"GABA" tilde(W)^(I E) I
-g_e^I (V_k^I - E_e) approx -g_e^I Delta V_"exc" = +g_e^I dot |E_e - V_"rest"|

C_m^E dot(V)_j^E & = -g_L^E (V_j^E - E_L) - g_i^E Delta V_"inh" + I_"ext" \
         C_m^I dot(V)_k^I & = -g_L^I (V_k^I - E_L) + g_e^I |Delta V_"exc"| \
    tau_"AMPA" dot(g)_e^I & = -g_e^I + tau_"AMPA" tilde(W)^(E I) E \
    tau_"GABA" dot(g)_i^E & = -g_i^E + tau_"GABA" tilde(W)^(I E) I
E(t) approx phi_E (I_"eff"^E (t)), quad I(t) approx phi_I (I_"eff"^I (t))
tau_E dot(E) = -E + Phi_E (I_"ext" - g_i^E Delta V_"inh")

tau_E dot(E) & = -E + Phi_E (I_"ext" - g_i^E Delta V_"inh") \
             tau_I dot(I) & = -I + Phi_I (g_e^I |Delta V_"exc"|) \
    tau_"AMPA" dot(g)_e^I & = -g_e^I + tau_"AMPA" tilde(W)^(E I) E \
    tau_"GABA" dot(g)_i^E & = -g_i^E + tau_"GABA" tilde(W)^(I E) I

W^(E I) eq.triple tilde(W)^(E I) dot |Delta V_"exc"|, quad
    W^(I E) eq.triple tilde(W)^(I E) dot Delta V_"inh"

tau_E dot(E) = -E + Phi_E (I_"ext" - h_i^E), quad
    tau_I dot(I) = -I + Phi_I (h_e^I)

tau_"AMPA" dot(h)_e^I = -h_e^I + tau_"AMPA" W^(E I) E, quad
    tau_"GABA" dot(h)_i^E = -h_i^E + tau_"GABA" W^(I E) I

phi(mu) &= [tau_"ref" + tau_m sqrt(pi) Q(mu)]^(-1), \
    Q(mu) &= integral_a^b e^(u^2) (1 + "erf" u) dif u, \
    a &= (V_"reset" - mu_V) \/ sigma_V, \
    b &= (V_"th" - mu_V) \/ sigma_V, \
    mu_V &= E_L + mu \/ g_L.

tilde(W)^(E I) = w^(E I) N_E = s, quad
    tilde(W)^(I E) = w^(I E) N_I = r s.
tau_E dot(E) = -E + Phi_E (I_"ext" - tau_"GABA" W^(I E) I),
tau_I dot(I) = -I + Phi_I (tau_"AMPA" W^(E I) E).
tau_"AMPA" dot(h)_e^I = -h_e^I + tau_"AMPA" W^(E I) Phi_E (I_"ext" - h_i^E),
tau_"GABA" dot(h)_i^E = -h_i^E + tau_"GABA" W^(I E) Phi_I (h_e^I),

tau_"GABA" dot(h)_i^E = -h_i^E + tau_"GABA" W^(I E)
        Phi_I (tau_"AMPA" W^(E I) E).
tau_I dot(I) = -I + Phi_I (tau_"AMPA" W^(E I) E),
tau_"GABA" dot(h)_i^E = -h_i^E + tau_"GABA" W^(I E) I,
A = max_(t in cal(W)) E(t) - min_(t in cal(W)) E(t),
Delta I = I_"ext" - I_"ext"^*, quad A approx C sqrt(Delta I),

A^2 approx C^2 Delta I, quad
    (dif A)/(dif I_"ext") approx C / (2 sqrt(Delta I)).
tilde(s)_j = min(s_j + bb(1) lr([u_j < frac(r_"add" dot Delta t, 1000)]), 1)
g_E^((t)) = d_A g_E^((t-1)) + tilde(bold(s))_E^((t-1)) W_(E E) + bold(s)_"in"^((t)) W_"in".
r_P = 1 / (M N_P T) sum_(b=1)^M sum_(n in P) z_(b n).
f_gamma = f_k + 1/2 (y_0 - y_2)/(y_0 - 2 y_1 + y_2) dot Delta f.
r_E = a + p dot f_gamma, quad r_E = p_0 dot f_gamma.

r_E = underbrace(a, "non-rhythmic contribution") +
    underbrace(p dot f_gamma, "cyclic contribution").
bold(s)^I_"base" in {0,1}^(T times B times N_I).

cal(E)[W_(k j)^(I E)] = j_(I E) = G_(I E) / N_I, quad
      cal(E)[sum_(k=1)^(N_I) W_(k j)^(I E)] = G_(I E).
Delta g_j^I = sum_(k in cal(A)) W_(k j)^(I E),
v_"out" (t) = beta_"out" v_"out" (t-1) + (1 - beta_"out") / (Delta t) bold(s)^E (t-1) W_"out". quad "(1)"
"logits"(t) = 1 / w_t sum_(u=t-w_t+1)^(t) v_"out" (u), quad w_t = min(w, t+1). quad "(2)"
hat(c)(t) = arg max_c p("class"=c, t). quad "(3)"
A(ell) = 1 / (⟨ r ⟩^2 (n - ell)) sum_(t=0)^(n-ell-1) r(t) r(t+ell).
g_i (t) = exp(-(Delta t) / tau_"AMPA") g_i (t-Delta t) + w S_i (t).

z_i = 1/N sum_(k=1)^N (v_i (k Delta t)-E_L)
        approx 1/T integral_0^T (v_i (t)-E_L) dif t.
r_"train" = min {r in cal(R): min_(s in cal(S)) A_s (r) >= 0.5}.

"Var"(z)=1/(2 pi) integral_(-oo)^oo abs(H_r (omega))^2 (r/1000) dif omega.
      quad "(3)"

abs(A_T (2 pi f/1000)) =
    abs(sin(pi f T_s)/(pi f T_s)). quad "(D1)"
g(t) = beta g(t-Delta t) + w S(t), quad "(A2)"
C (d v)/(d t) = g_L (E_L-v) + g(t)(E_e-v). quad "(A4)"

macron(v)_r =
    (g_L E_L + macron(g)_r E_e) /
    (g_L + macron(g)_r). quad "(A7)"

G_r (omega) =
    w/(i omega + 1/tau_"AMPA") dot
    (E_e-macron(v)_r)/
    (i omega C + g_L + macron(g)_r). quad "(A9)"
A_T (omega) = (1-exp(-i omega T))/(i omega T), quad "(A10)"

"Var"_"linear" (z) = 1/(2 pi) integral_(-oo)^oo
    abs(H_r (omega))^2 S_"in" (omega) dif omega. quad "(A15)"

g=macron(g)_r+delta g,
    quad v=macron(v)_r+delta v,
    quad s=r/1000+delta s.
(d delta g)/(d t) = -delta g/tau_"AMPA" + w delta s. quad "(B3)"
delta g(omega)=w/(i omega+1/tau_"AMPA") delta s(omega). quad "(B4)"

C (d delta v)/(d t)
    =-(g_L+macron(g)_r)delta v
      +(E_e-macron(v)_r)delta g. quad "(B5)"
delta z = 1/T integral_0^T delta v(t) dif t. quad "(B6)"

A_T (omega)=1/T integral_0^T exp(-i omega t) dif t
    =(1-exp(-i omega T))/(i omega T),
z_c (u) = sum_(t=a)^u s_c^"out" (t), quad a <= u < b.
R = abs(1 / N sum_(n=1)^N exp(i delta phi_n))
C_m (dif V) / (dif t) = -g_L (V - E_L) - g_e (V - E_e) - g_i (V - E_i) quad (3)
C_m^E (dif V^E) / (dif t) = -g_L^E (V^E - E_L) - g_e^E (V^E - E_e) - g_i^E (V^E - E_i) quad (4)
C_m^I (dif V^I) / (dif t) = -g_L^I (V^I - E_L) - g_e^I (V^I - E_e) quad (5)
s_(t+1) = chi_(t+1) bb(1)[U_(t+1) >= V_"th"], quad V_(t+1) = cases(V_"reset" & "if spiking or refractory", U_(t+1) & "otherwise"). quad (6)
(dif g^E_e) / (dif t) = -(g^E_e) / (tau_"AMPA") + W_"in" sum_k delta(t - t^"inp"_k) quad (7)
(dif g^E_i) / (dif t) = -(g^E_i) / (tau_"GABA") + W_"ie" sum_k delta(t - t^i_k) quad (8)
(dif g^I_e) / (dif t) = -(g^I_e) / (tau_"AMPA") + W_"ei" sum_k delta(t - t^e_k) quad (9)
g_(t+1) = e^(-Delta t \/ tau) g_t + s_t W
C_m (dif V) / (dif t) = -(g_L + g_e + g_i) V + (g_L E_L + g_e E_e + g_i E_i) quad (10)
(C_m) / (g_"tot") (dif V) / (dif t) = -(V - (g_L E_L + g_e E_e + g_i E_i) / (g_"tot")) quad (11)
V_(t+1) = V_oo + (V_t - V_oo) e^(-Delta t \/ tau_"eff") quad (12)
g_"tot"^E = g_L^E + g_e^E + g_i^E, quad tau_"eff"^E = (C_m^E) / (g_"tot"^E), quad V_oo^E = (g_L^E E_L + g_e^E E_e + g_i^E E_i) / (g_"tot"^E) quad (13)
g_"tot"^I = g_L^I + g_e^I, quad tau_"eff"^I = (C_m^I) / (g_"tot"^I), quad V_oo^I = (g_L^I E_L + g_e^I E_e) / (g_"tot"^I) quad (14)
V^p_(t+1) = V^p_oo + (V^p_t - V^p_oo) e^(-Delta t \/ tau^p_"eff")
N_E chevron.l r_E chevron.r + N_I chevron.l r_I chevron.r

C_m^E (dif V^E) / (dif t) &= -g_L^E (V^E - E_L) - g_e^E (V^E - E_e) - g_i^E (V^E - E_i) \
    C_m^I (dif V^I) / (dif t) &= -g_L^I (V^I - E_L) - g_e^I (V^I - E_e)
s_(t+1) = bold(1)[V >= V_"th"], quad V <- V_"reset" "if" s_(t+1) = 1 "or refractory".

(dif g^E_e) / (dif t) &= -(g^E_e) / (tau_"AMPA") + W_"in" sum_k delta(t - t^"inp"_k) \
    (dif g^E_i) / (dif t) &= -(g^E_i) / (tau_"GABA") + W^(I E) sum_k delta(t - t^i_k) \
    (dif g^I_e) / (dif t) &= -(g^I_e) / (tau_"AMPA") + W^(E I) sum_k delta(t - t^e_k)

tau_E dot(macron(E)) &= -macron(E) + Phi_E (I_"ext" - macron(g)_i^E Delta V_"inh") \
    tau_I dot(macron(I)) &= -macron(I) + Phi_I (macron(g)_e^I Delta V_"exc") \
    tau_"AMPA" dot(macron(g))_e^I &= -macron(g)_e^I + tau_"AMPA" W^(E I) macron(E) \
    tau_"GABA" dot(macron(g))_i^E &= -macron(g)_i^E + tau_"GABA" W^(I E) macron(I)
Phi(mu) = [ tau_"ref" + tau_m sqrt(pi) integral_((V_"reset" - mu_V) \/ sigma_V)^((V_"th" - mu_V) \/ sigma_V) e^(u^2) (1 + "erf" u) dif u ]^(-1),

r_b = 1 / (N_E T) sum_(i in E) z_(b i), quad
    cal(L) = cal(L)_"CE" + s_u / B sum_b "ReLU"(r_b - r_"ceil")^2,
N_E chevron.l r_E chevron.r + N_I chevron.l r_I chevron.r
V_oo = (g_L E_L + g_e E_e + g_i E_i) \/ g_"tot"
V_(t+1) = V_oo + (V_t - V_oo) e^(-Delta t \/ tau_"eff").
